messages:
Ashley (sales): Heads-up: regional bank wants a short BYO-HSM/BYO-KMS POC. They need: perf impact (p50/p95), simple pricing comparison for procurement, minimal firewall IP/port list, and answers for their security questionnaire. Keep it 1 page.
Ben (platform): BYO unwrap = auth + network RTT. Ballpark +10-50ms depending on their KMS RTT. Mitigation: local DEK sidecar with caching (reduces unwraps to ~auth window).
Claire (crypto): Ask: do they require FIPS 140-2/3 attestation, split key ceremonies, or dual-custody? Those add lead time and SOW items.
Maya (security): For their questionnaire we'll provide: KEK ownership model (customer-owned), rotation cadence options, attestation artifacts we can supply, audit log export (syslog/S3), and revocation/playbook bullets.
Devon (solutions): I'll assemble a tiny perf harness + a curl example they can run from their network. Recommend 1k requests, concurrency 8-16, capture p50/p95. We can offer a 60-min on-call window for the run.
Ben (platform): Pricing guidance: recommend one-time connector/setup fee (covers attestation/provisioning) + variable ops estimate. Example: if KMS charges $0.03 per 10k unwraps => ~$0.30 per 100k. Show best/worst (same-region vs cross-region) sensitivity.
Maya (security): Network: outbound HTTPS (443) to their KMS IPs/endpoints. If on-prem HSM, we need IP allowlist and optionally mTLS client certs. Provide sample iptables and diagram.
ops-bot: Ticket created: #SUP-3001 assigned to Devon (solutions)  POC planner due 72h.
Ashley (sales): Action items: Devon -> perf harness + run instructions and offer on-call; Ben -> ports/iplist + cost sensitivity table; Claire & Maya -> attestation checklist + questionnaire answers and rotation FAQ. I'll bundle into a 1-page "POC brief" and send to the prospect once items ready. :thumbsup:
